FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Research Scholar(s)
to work on various NDDS level drug delivery systems for clinical applications in
the IPCA foundation industrial project sanctioned to undersigned.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for a interview through telephone/email in the
office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh
ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:
 M. Pharm/M.S. (Pharmaceutics/Industrial Pharmacy or any other equivalent
discipline).
 Minimum of 55% marks at Graduate and Master’s levels both (50% in case of
SC/ST/PH)
 Qualified in GPAT, GATE, UGC-NET or PU PhD entrance exam.
DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:
 One year research/industry experience (JRF)
 Two year research/industry experience (SRF)
Fellowship:
 Monthly emoluments of Rs. 20,000/- p.m. (fixed) for JRF &
25,000/- (fixed) p.m. for SRF. The amount can be enhanced depending on the
experience & expertise.
Sd/- Sd/-
Professor O P Katare
Principal Investigator
Prof Indu Pal Kaur
Co-Principal Investigator
Scanned copies of all the educational degrees, experience and Curriculum vitae is to
be send by post or email at dropkatareuips@gmail.com latest by 23.04.2023
Note: The selected candidate can be offered Ph.D. registration under the project.
